_readme: Portfolio projects, in display order. 'featured' puts a project in the homepage sequence (order = featured value). 'published: false' keeps a project off the site entirely. 'status' is the label visitors see; keep it accurate (Preview, Concept, In progress, Launched). Screenshots live in assets/images/work/<slug>/<id>.webp and are captured with tools/capture-screenshots.mjs. 'colors' theme the project's own feature panel and case study.
